name: Microgrid restoration abort-condition interface
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Coordinates the documented response when a required restoration condition is lost.
description: Coordinates the documented response when a required restoration condition is lost. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Lost prerequisite or fault state” at the input and “Assigned restoration-abort request” at the output. The resulting system state must be defined.
